XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for Moodle local/artqtml Light

TABLE.NAME: local_artqtml_generations
TABLE.COMMENT: Site-wide AI quiz question generation jobs (Glob-022/023: not course-scoped)

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the generation

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Generation name given by the user (Felt-001/002)

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Alnum shortname used in generated question codes, e.g. BIO1 (Felt-003/004/005)

FIELD.NAME: sourcetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Uploaded/typed source text used for generation

FIELD.NAME: sourcetexthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the normalised source text, used for duplicate detection (Felt-021)

FIELD.NAME: sourcefilehash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the raw uploaded source file's bytes (before text extraction), null if the source was pasted text with no file (M-19: catches identical files whose extracted text differs)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: started, generating, validating, saving, completed, failed (M-15: saving is a distinct third pipeline stage between validating and completed)

FIELD.NAME: settings
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded generation settings: difficulty mode, per-type counts and options, seed, knowledge source

FIELD.NAME: draftcategoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: question_categories.id of this generation's isolated draft bank (Jov-002/Glob-025)

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Technical error message from the last failed Claude/Gemini API call (Gen-014)

FIELD.NAME: processingtoken
FIELD.COMMENT: Random token set by an atomic UPDATE to claim this generation for processing; NULL means unclaimed (C-02: prevents two concurrent task runs processing the same generation)

FIELD.NAME: pendingdata
FIELD.COMMENT: M-15: JSON holding the raw Claude questions and, once validated, the Gemini evaluations - held here (not in local_artqtml_questions) between the generating/validating/saving stages, so nothing is written to local_artqtml_questions until the saving stage commits it all in one transaction. Cleared once saving succeeds.

FIELD.NAME: countdiscrepancy
FIELD.COMMENT: M-08: JSON list of {type, requested, received} for any question type where Claude's actual output didn't match the requested count, null if none

TABLE.NAME: local_artqtml_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Individual AI-generated questions belonging to a generation, stored in an isolated draft bank

FIELD.NAME: generationid
FIELD.COMMENT: The generation this question belongs to

FIELD.NAME: questioncode
FIELD.COMMENT: Plugin-generated code, e.g. BIO1-IH-0001 (spec 3.3.1)

FIELD.NAME: typecode
FIELD.COMMENT: IH/FE/SR (ArtQTML Light type codes)

FIELD.NAME: questiontype
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle qtype: truefalse, multichoice, ordering, shortanswer, essay

FIELD.NAME: questiontext
FIELD.COMMENT: The generated question text

FIELD.NAME: difficultylabel
FIELD.COMMENT: Emlékezés/Megértés/Alkalmazás, Könnyű/Közepes/Nehéz, or empty for free-text mode

FIELD.NAME: sourcereference
FIELD.COMMENT: Short reference into the source text this question was derived from

FIELD.NAME: questiondata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded type-specific fields from the AI response

FIELD.NAME: validationsuggestion
FIELD.COMMENT: accepted, needs_review, rejected or not_evaluated (Val-017)

FIELD.NAME: problemcategory
FIELD.COMMENT: Validator problem category: one of ok/factual_error/ambiguous_wording/other; 'ok' for accepted, NULL until evaluated (Val-019/Val-028)

FIELD.NAME: justification
FIELD.COMMENT: Validator's short justification text (Val-018)

FIELD.NAME: confidence
FIELD.COMMENT: Validator confidence percentage 0-100 (Val-018)

FIELD.NAME: validationdata
FIELD.COMMENT: Complete raw Gemini evaluation object for this question (question_id/suggestion/problem_category/justification/confidence/hint_quality/feedback_quality as returned), JSON encoded, null if not yet evaluated - problemcategory/justification/confidence above are the normalised/whitelisted values used for sorting and safe display

FIELD.NAME: questionbankid
FIELD.COMMENT: id of the real Moodle question row, created immediately in the draft bank category (Gen-005)

FIELD.NAME: movedout
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 once the question has been moved out of the draft category into a real target bank

FIELD.NAME: approved
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 once a teacher has explicitly approved this question; required before it can be moved to a real bank

FIELD.NAME: edited
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if a teacher has edited this question since its last validation (Jov-026/M-20); validationsuggestion is reset to not_evaluated rather than storing a synthetic 'edited' suggestion value, and the UI's Edited badge is driven by this flag instead

FIELD.NAME: lasteditedby
FIELD.COMMENT: M-30: userid of whoever last edited this question in the native question editor, null if never edited

FIELD.NAME: lasteditedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Glob-032: timestamp of lasteditedby's edit, null if never edited - used to find the single most-recently-edited question across a generation for the list page's 'Modified by' column

FIELD.NAME: approvedby
FIELD.COMMENT: M-30: userid of whoever approved this question, null if not yet approved

TABLE.NAME: local_artqtml_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Event log entries for AI quiz question generations (technical annex ch.7/8)

FIELD.NAME: generationid
FIELD.COMMENT: The generation this log entry relates to; NULL for entries not tied to a generation and for entries whose generation has since been deleted - see originalgenerationid

FIELD.NAME: originalgenerationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Historical id of a generation that has been deleted. While the generation exists its id is in generationid and this is NULL; deletion moves the id here and sets generationid to NULL. Glob-040 keeps the log entry itself, and this is what keeps it traceable without leaving generationid pointing at a row that is gone. Deliberately not a foreign key: the row it names no longer exists.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who initiated the action that produced this event

FIELD.NAME: event
FIELD.COMMENT: Event identifier, e.g. generation_started, ai_call_made, ai_call_failed

FIELD.NAME: calltype
FIELD.COMMENT: generate or validate, for ai_call_* events

FIELD.NAME: provider
FIELD.COMMENT: claude or gemini, for ai_call_* events

FIELD.NAME: httpstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: HTTP response status code of the AI call

FIELD.NAME: tokensinput
FIELD.COMMENT: Input token usage for this call

FIELD.NAME: tokensoutput
FIELD.COMMENT: Output token usage for this call

FIELD.NAME: jsonattempt
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-fallback retry sequence number (2.3), independent of the HTTP retry counter

FIELD.NAME: isretry
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if this call is a JSON-fallback retry whose tokens are excluded from the monthly budget (Val-009)

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: API-provided request/trace id, for support escalation

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: success or error

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Technical error message (error.message), only set when result=error

FIELD.NAME: data
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded extra event data

TABLE.NAME: local_artqtml_modelcheck
TABLE.COMMENT: Diagnostic log of scheduled and manual model checks (Admin-061/063). Documented, stable public interface: administrators read it with Configurable Reports, so renaming or dropping a column is a breaking change.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the check ran

FIELD.NAME: provider
FIELD.COMMENT: anthropic or gemini

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: The model identifier that was checked

FIELD.NAME: checktype
FIELD.COMMENT: availability or structure

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: success or failure

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: AIQ-YYYYMMDD-XXXX, only on failure

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Shortened error description. The raw provider response is deliberately NOT stored (Admin-061).

FIELD.NAME: duration
FIELD.COMMENT: Call duration in milliseconds

FIELD.NAME: triggertype
FIELD.COMMENT: scheduled or manual. Named triggertype, not trigger: TRIGGER is a reserved word and cannot be referenced unquoted in MariaDB or PostgreSQL, which would break the Configurable Reports queries this table exists to serve.

FIELD.NAME: pluginversion
FIELD.COMMENT: The plugin version this check ran under (BL-44). A structure failure excludes a model from the dropdown, but only while the plugin is unchanged: on 2026-08-03 two models failed in the morning and worked in the afternoon, because the defect was ours. A version bump therefore reopens every excluded model for checking.

INDEX.NAME: provider_timecreated
INDEX.COMMENT: The natural Configurable Reports access pattern: latest entries for one provider.
